audit.why: The packet defect describes a 7/7-Ziggs chart, but both layers on disk already read Ziggs, Ziggs, Ziggs, Skill, Ziggs, Skill, Ziggs and agree row for row. The mirror's note confirms Level 1 stays Ziggs (Bouncing Bomb 850 against Ntofo Strikes 450) and does not give me its realigned values for rows 1-5, so I did not guess at flips.
audit.corrected: Chart left unchanged; ratings left unchanged. Flagged in questionsForUser.

audit.whatIsWrong: No K'Sante cooldowns anywhere; the level 4-5 and first-item stages were generic Ziggs boilerplate.
audit.why: Path Maker 14s at rank 1 and All Out 120s at rank 1 are the two windows that decide when Ziggs may hold ground.
audit.corrected: phases[3].why, phases[5].why, breakdown.cooldowns and report[5] now carry them.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four fields call the two-stack Ntofo Strikes effect a 'Q3 dash'. Riot's text says at 2 stacks it fires a shockwave that PULLS enemies in — it is not a dash and there is no third stack. The dash is Path Maker (W) / Footwork (E). Path Maker's true damage, its reduced damage taken while charging, and All Out's healing and wall-knockback are all unstated.
audit.why: A Ziggs player sidestepping an imaginary dash walks straight into a pull, and one who pokes a charging K'Sante spends mana into damage reduction.
audit.corrected: Named the shockwave pull at 450 in whys[2], mid, spikes[0] and wants.foe[1]; added true damage to phases[3].why, the charge's damage reduction to spikes[0], the 250-range wall knockback and heal to report[5], and the Dauntless Instinct reset tell to dontsFull[0].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: All Out heals him and nothing on the page mentions Grievous Wounds.
audit.why: missingInteractions needs-antiheal; chip damage into an All Out K'Sante is refunded.

edits.before: Stack Manaflow and chip K'Sante below 60% — that's the zone where R + jungle help executes. Track All Out before every step-up.
edits.after: Path Maker is 14s at rank 1, does true damage and stuns — armour does not read this trade, so step up only while it is down.

edits.before: Blackfire Torch spike — your Q chunks become unhealable burn chip. K'Sante now chooses between farm and HP every wave.
edits.after: Torch burn is real, but All Out heals him through chip — have Grievous Wounds up before you commit anything to a kill.

edits.before: Track K'Sante’s All Out: His duelist mode — fight the tank, never the duelist. Forward steps wait for its downtime.
edits.after: All Out, 120s at rank 1, knocks you through walls at 250 and heals him — Satchel out of the follow-up, do not tank it.

edits.before: - K'Sante All Out: matchup-defining — His duelist mode — fight the tank, never the duelist. It governs your forward steps. - W Satchel spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - K'Sante All Out: 120s at rank 1 — his duelist mode, so fight the tank and never the duelist. - Path Maker is 14s and lands true damage straight through your resistances. - W Satchel spent on poke is a death you scheduled.

edits.before: That is K'Sante’s rehearsed moment — don’t audition for it.
edits.after: His Dauntless Instinct wind-up is the tell — step back on it.

edits.before: By 3 your full kit spaces his only Q3 dash engage.
edits.after: By 3 you space his Ntofo pull, which only reaches 450.

edits.before: Land Q3 to dash in and start his short-cooldown combo
edits.after: Land the Ntofo shockwave to pull you into his combo

edits.before: Levels 3-6 are all yours: you have Q, W and E to space him while his only engage is a slow W charge or a telegraphed Q3 dash. Layer E Hexplosive Minefield on your own feet so any dash into you eats the mines, and reset his approach with poke.
edits.after: Levels 3-6 are yours: space him while his only engage is a 14s Path Maker charge or the two-stack Ntofo shockwave that pulls you in at 450. Layer E Hexplosive Minefield on your own feet so any dash in eats the mines, and reset his approach with poke.

edits.before: With Q, W and E online you outrange K'Sante's entire kit; his Q Ntofo Strikes only reaches when he's already on top of you, so poke him down as he tries to walk up and drop E Hexplosive Minefield the instant he dashes his third Q.
edits.after: With Q, W and E online you outrange K'Sante's whole kit; Ntofo Strikes reaches only 450 and at two stacks fires a shockwave that pulls you in, so poke him on the walk-up and drop E the instant he charges Path Maker — he takes reduced damage during that charge.

notes: The 'Q3 dash' error was repeated in four places and is a real mechanical falsehood: two Ntofo Strikes stacks produce a shockwave that pulls, and the dashes are Path Maker and Footwork. Packet has only 4 games at 25%, so no win-rate-driven chart change was made. See questionsForUser about the chart rows the mirror realigned.
